findings.text: the cited sha 04b6ede92 does not resolve in this repository (git rev-parse '04b6ede92^{commit}' -> fatal: Needed a single revision); the regenerated-figures commit is 04b6eee92968278dc6df1679020f20baa2d9d4; the same truncated sha appears in the archive at line 339 and in 0bcc2ff49's commit body, and a reader following any of the three lands on nothing

the caption says the earlier H200-run values differ from the committed receipt in their last digits; the base receipt (source revision 95e17e2cd60515875f731dc464ff72077ea433b5) carries 2.9370993484545416e-09, 1.7919866979188015e-10 and 1.734723475976807e-14 against the committed 3.275591603513206e-11, 1.3553394517806794e-11 and 3.929318675988114e-09, so the earlier values stand about 90, 13 and 226000 times the committed ones; the same phrase recurs at line 350 of the archive and line 27 of the reviewed manifest; the mechanism claim of a device-dependent noise floor is right and only the magnitude wording is wrong

the log names revision cec822195 as the revision it ran at, but the test committed at that revision opens docs/figures/constraint-augmented-newton-krylov/edge-constraint/edge-contours-render.json and the figure directory at cec822195 holds only edge-contours.png and receipt.json - the render receipt arrives in 04b6eee92; the recorded pass therefore cannot be reproduced at the revision the log names, so the log is committed evidence for a tree state that did not exist

item_verdicts.diff: cec822195 adds the receipt-driven panels and the exponent-title test; 04b6eee92 regenerates both figures, persists the render inputs and their receipt from the titan solve, and re-anchors the title test on the committed receipt; 0bcc2ff49 lands the plan comment and the evidence anchor; all three carry bodies
item_verdicts.done_when: reviewer re-ran the node's gate on a git archive of the committed revision (4 passed in 10.33s, exit 0) and re-ran the reviewed node's declared mutation in the same scratch tree, with the committed receipt held fixed (1 failed, 3 passed, exit 1); the red state is exactly the exponent-title assertion failing and the log's first line repeats the declared string verbatim
item_verdicts.goal: read the prompt, the plan comment and the three commits; the panels are drawn from the committed receipt with an exponent-form title composed from each command's own terminal_position_error_mm, every panel records and draws both null sets with the axis off, every drawn marker key has a figure legend entry, and --render-only redraws the figures from the persisted inputs with no solve
item_verdicts.manifest: status complete with the three commits, the eight changed paths, the gate command and its result, and the declared control; check-manifest audits ok (exit 0, no findings); the evidence_inputs claim that the earlier values differ only in their last digits is false (finding 2) and two records carry the truncated sha 04b6ede92 (finding 1)
item_verdicts.write_paths: the diff touches 8 files across the three commits, every one inside the six assigned fence entries (two of them directories); no concurrent node exists; the plan change is additive and the archive's other sections are untouched

justifications.durability: all three commits carry bodies and the record is committed in the reviewed worktree; but a bisect stops at cec822195 - the test committed there opens the render receipt that only 04b6eee92 commits, so the test cannot pass anywhere before its fixture lands - and the landed record carries the unresolvable sha 04b6ede92 at three sites (finding 1)
justifications.evidence: reproduced independently on a scratch archive of the committed revision - the gate 4 passed, the declared mutation reddens exactly the exponent-title assertion with the fixture held fixed, the drawn SVG titles match the render receipt and the receipt's terminal errors match the panel titles; the deductions are the committed gate log, which cannot be reproduced at the revision it names because the render receipt it reads arrives only in the next commit (finding 3), and the evidence_inputs magnitude claim contradicted by the two committed receipts (finding 2)
justifications.fit: the node answers the exponent-title half of the driving followup, keeps the commanded-displacement inset and the remaining audit deductions under follow_ons, and leaves the followup open for the coordinator
justifications.goal_fidelity: the fence condition is met - the panels print each command's error in exponent form read from the receipt and every panel records and draws both null sets; the deductions are record defects in the delivered bundle, the last-digits mischaracterisation at manifest:27 and the archive (finding 2) and the truncated sha (finding 1)
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff is exactly the eight files of the fence's six entries; no concurrent node exists; the plan meta lines and the archive's other sections are untouched
